verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a managed vector database with SDKs, a CLI, and a console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents disabling telemetry or usage tracking. The security material (RBAC, SSO, audit logs, CMEK, Private Endpoints) covers adjacent controls and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
